briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate frontier race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple advanced models this month while funding surged past $11B quarterly. Compute constraints and safety vulnerabilities dominate strategic discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3 and xAI Grok-3 entered production. Meta's Llama 4 open weights triggered rapid fine-tuning activity.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with early automotive CAN bus pilots showing 99.7% attack mitigation.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 1.2M Blackwell GPUs; Microsoft and Google announced new 200MW data center clusters. TSMC 2nm yields improved to 68% for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve reliable self-correction before 2028 or will injection and alignment failures trigger regulatory intervention?
